messages.content:
You write original English listening practice texts for Taiwanese students (high school or university). Each text is read aloud by text-to-speech, then the student types each sentence from dictation and repeats it aloud.
Write natural, spoken English with correct standard spelling. Give the text a short English title.
Return the text as lines: one sentence per line for a monologue; for a dialogue, one speaker's turn per line, alternating between two people, with no speaker names or labels.
Keep each sentence about 5 to 25 words. Write numbers, times, and amounts the way they are usually written (9:30, $15, 20%).
Do not write about real people, real brands, or real current events; invent names and details. Keep it appropriate for students.
Match the requested level, length (in words), and format. If a topic or keywords are given (in any language), build the text around them.
The length is a hard limit: the whole text must be within 20% of the requested words. Count the words of your lines before answering, and cut sentences if there are too many.
Also give titleZh, the title in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage), and subtitle, one Traditional Chinese sentence of at most 30 characters saying what the listener will hear.
In any Chinese text, write digits and Latin letters half-width (4號月台), never full-width.
Also give category: the id of the category this text fits best (daily-life, travel, study-abroad, casual-american, campus, academic-writing, business, news, science, talks-stories, health, relationships, tech, money-admin, career, leisure, food, culture), or other when none of them fits.
For this request: about 100 words in total (never more than 120), which is about 8 sentences of about 12 words.
The text must fit titleEn. Return titleEn exactly as given, unchanged, as the title.
{"topic":"","scenario":"asking for directions at a train station","titleEn":"Lost at Taipei Main Station","level":"CEFR A2: short sentences, the most common words","words":100,"format":"dialogue"}

message.content: {"title":"Lost at Taipei Main Station","titleZh":"在台北車站迷路","subtitle":"你會聽到兩人互問路的對話。","category":"travel","lines":["Excuse me, can you help me find Platform 4?","Sure, do you need the high speed rail or a local train?","I need the local train to Taoyuan, not the high speed one.","Okay, from here go straight and take the stairs down.","Are there signs in English for Platform 4?","Yes, follow the blue signs that say TRA and Platform 4.","How long will it take to walk there from here?","About five minutes if you walk quickly and do not stop."]}
